source_name: Construction and Real Estate Operator Enterprise Information Search System - takken operator search (kensetsugyosha takkengyosha to kigyo joho kensaku system)
provider: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism (MLIT); prefectural governors issue prefecture licenses
geographic_coverage: National Japan incl all four target prefectures (Tokyo, Saitama, Chiba, Kanagawa); both MLIT-licensed and prefecture-licensed operators searchable
temporal_coverage: current searchable registry; per-record license date (menkyo nengappi) and license validity period (menkyo no yuko kikan) in detail records
record_unit: one licensed real estate broker (takken operator) per license number (menkyo bango)
expected_bias: generic real-estate brokers measuring general housing-market service capacity, NOT migrant-oriented; no foreign-resident/Chinese-language/multilingual marker in official fields; correlates with general commercial/housing density; over-represents central business districts
notes: authoritative national source is search-only; no confirmed CSV/Excel/bulk download or API (system menu and MLIT list pages sosei_const_tk3_000037/000038 checked); per-record fields rich (menkyo bango, shogo, daihyosha, honten shozaichi, shiten shozaichi, shihonkin, menkyo nengappi, menkyo yuko kikan, kengyo, shozoku dantai) and would support observable-by-2024 inference and municipality linkage IF acquired; license number prefix encodes MLIT (kokudokotsudaijin) vs prefecture (chiji); Saitama page redirects to this system; physical meibo inspection only at prefectural offices

source_name: Tokyo takken operator license information service (takuchi tatemono torihiki gyosha menkyo joho teikyo service)
provider: Tokyo Metropolitan Government, Housing Policy Headquarters, Real Estate Business Division
geographic_coverage: Tokyo only (operators with head office in Tokyo); does NOT cover Saitama/Chiba/Kanagawa
temporal_coverage: electronic browsing limited to NEW or RENEWED licenses received on or after 2025-04-01 (reiwa 7); strong temporal truncation
record_unit: one Tokyo-licensed real estate broker per operator
expected_bias: Tokyo-only; same non-migrant generic housing-market bias; electronic browsing right-truncated to post-2025-04-01 licenses so cannot reconstruct 2024 active stock
notes: free online browsing but electronic browsing covers only post-2025-04-01 new/renewed licenses (cannot reconstruct 2024 active stock); full meibo inspection in person at Tokyo metro govt building 2, 3F, 300 yen per record; Tokyo only so cannot serve the four-prefecture 251 frame alone
